name: Parental Love
overview: Scripture reveals parental love as a God-ordained responsibility marked by honor, discipline, and instruction. Parents are called to honor and teach their children diligently, as seen in commands to honor father and mother and to heed parental guidance (Exodus 20:12; Proverbs 1:8). This love is both compassionate and corrective, reflecting God's own pity and care for His people (Psalms 103:13) and includes timely discipline to guide children in righteousness (Proverbs 13:24). Ultimately, training children in the way they should go establishes a foundation for lifelong faithfulness (Proverbs 22:6).
